Priya (CSM): Helio Labs seeing a big burst of 429s on SDK init in staging — can we triage?
Helio-Dev (customer): yes, just deployed and ~150 instances call sdk.init() at boot. here's representative lines from our logs:
```
POST /v1/session 429 {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":1}
POST /v1/session 429 {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":1}
POST /v1/session 200 {"token":"..."}
```
Luca (SDK): which SDK version? older releases didn't coalesce preflight requests.
Helio-Dev (customer): we're on 0.8.5.
Aisha (Support): ok--short checklist: 1) enable preflight coalescing env vars (works on 0.8.x), 2) bump token TTL temporarily, 3) add jitter/backoff to init. I'll paste commands.
Luca (SDK): env examples (bash):
```
export REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_COALESCE=true
export REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_SPLAY_MS=300
export REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_MAX_BATCH=10
```
Luca (SDK): and node backoff snippet:
```
async function initWithRetry(){
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ try{return await sdk.init()}catch(e){await sleep((50*Math.pow(2,i))+Math.random()*100)} }
  throw e
}
```
Sam (SRE): also note your token TTL is 8s per our config -> restarting many processes will re-request tokens. Increase to 60s for staging while testing.
Helio-Dev (customer): switching TTL to 60s now, and set env vars. Re-deploying.
onboard-bot: feature-flag "prefetch-coalesce-compat" ON for helio-staging by Priya (CSM)
Helio-Dev (customer): new logs:
```
POST /v1/session 200 {"token":"..."}
POST /v1/session 200 {"token":"..."}
429s: dropped from ~140 -> 4 in first minute
```
Aisha (Support): great — I'll draft a one-pager runbook with exact env vars, TTL guidance, and an upgrade note to 0.9.x where coalescing is default.
Priya (CSM): action: Helio runs load test and reports back; SDK team to prepare a compatibility flag for earlier SDKs; Support will capture runbook and follow up for renewal health check.
Helio-Dev (customer): will do load test at 1400 PT and share results. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
